aviso3d.texto: Your browser has it turned off, or your graphics card does not support it. The nights can still be played, but the prologue, the on-foot sections and the ending of Night 7 are in 3D and will not be shown.
aviso3d.chrome: Chrome: Settings → System → "Use graphics acceleration when available" → Relaunch.
aviso3d.edge: Edge: Settings → System and performance → "Use graphics acceleration when available" → Restart.
aviso3d.firefox: Firefox: Settings → General → Performance → untick "Use recommended performance settings" and tick "Use hardware acceleration when available" → restart Firefox.
aviso3d.ya: If it was already on: update your graphics card driver (NVIDIA, AMD or Intel) or try another browser.

posit.texto:
Don't turn off the corridor lights, even if they ask you to over the radio.

—M.

protocolo.texto:
In the event of a breach, the Central Corridor will be sealed.

No one gets in.
No one gets out.

protocolo_n12.texto:
Central Corridor sealed as a precaution.

Do not open the door
without orders from the bridge.

protocolo_n3.texto:
The Central Corridor seal has failed.

If you hear footsteps behind you,
don't turn around without a light.

protocolo_n4.texto:
Crew unaccounted for.

At dawn, hide.
Don't open up for anyone.

protocolo_n6.texto:
Cryogenic leak contained by hand.

Sector sealed off.
At 6:00, don't expect relief.

lab.texto:
It backs away from direct light.

Turning the intensity up doesn't calm it.
It makes it angry.

medbay.texto:
Cryogenics has stopped answering.

Yesterday there were eleven of us in the mess hall.
Today I counted six trays.

hangar.texto:
Shuttle 2 is out of fuel.

I'm sorry.

cryo.texto:
Pod 3: one more degree and it wakes up.

DO NOT TOUCH THE PANEL.

greenhouse.texto:
The plants have been dying since they opened the ducts.

Something is eating the roots.

aviso_inicio.contenido: This game contains scares with loud sounds, bloody violence and scenes that may be distressing.
aviso_inicio.luces: There are flashing lights and flashes. If you have photosensitive epilepsy or flashing lights affect you, be careful when playing.
aviso_inicio.auriculares: For the best experience, play with headphones and in the dark.
aviso_inicio.req_sistema_web: A current browser with WebGL2 (Chrome, Edge or Firefox)
aviso_inicio.req_cpu_v: 4 cores (tested on a 13th-gen Intel Core i5)
aviso_inicio.req_ram_v: 8 GB of RAM (the ending uses about 6 GB)
aviso_inicio.req_gpu_v: With WebGL2; an integrated one works (tested on an Intel UHD)
aviso_inicio.req_disco_web: About 450 MB downloaded while you play
